shots.run: const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const until=async(f,n=60)=>{for(let i=0;i<n&&!f();i++)await wait(250);return f();};const vis=e=>e&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0;const txt=(t,sel='button,a,label,summary,h2,h3,[role=tab]')=>[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].find(e=>vis(e)&&(e.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()===t||e.getAttribute('aria-label')===t));const starts=(t,sel='button,a,label,summary,h2,h3,[role=tab]')=>[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].find(e=>vis(e)&&e.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().startsWith(t));const tag=(e,n,c=true)=>{if(!e)throw new Error('no element for '+n);e.dataset.shot=n;if(c){document.body.style.paddingBottom='400px';e.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});}return e;};const click=async(t,sel)=>{await until(()=>txt(t,sel));const e=txt(t,sel);if(!e)throw new Error('no '+t);e.click();await wait(800);};const clickStarts=async(t,sel)=>{await until(()=>starts(t,sel));starts(t,sel).click();await wait(800);};const adv=async()=>{await until(()=>document.querySelector('#advanced-switch'));const s=document.querySelector('#advanced-switch');if(!s.checked){s.click();await wait(1000);}};const tab=async(t)=>{await until(()=>txt(t,'[role=tab]'));txt(t,'[role=tab]').click();await wait(700);};const fld=(t)=>{const l=txt(t,'label');if(!l)throw new Error('no field '+t);return l.closest('.field')||l.closest('.settings-row')||l;};const set=(el,v)=>{el.value=v;el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));};const top=()=>window.scrollTo(0,0);const pick=(sel,text)=>{const o=[...sel.options].find(x=>x.text.trim()===text||x.text.includes(text));if(!o)throw new Error('no option '+text);set(sel,o.value);};const sw1=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('main input[type=checkbox]')].filter(x=>x.id!=='advanced-switch'&&vis(x.closest('label')||x))[0];const row=(e)=>e.closest('.setting')||e.closest('li')||e.closest('label')||e;await click('Edit Jellyfin','button'); await until(()=>txt('Test connection','button'));
shots.alt: The Edit Jellyfin panel, with Test connection (step 4) and Save app (step 5) outlined
